title: Zendaya's birth chart
metaDescription: Zendaya's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 9.6° Virgo. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Tightest of all, Mars holds an opposition to Neptune at 0.4° — close enough to weld drive to imagination. An opposition is the tradition’s tug of war. Both ends are real, and the work is holding them at once rather than picking a winner.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: 9.6° of Virgo is the Sun's exact seat — first decan, 0°–10°, sub-ruled by Mercury in the old triplicity scheme. The degree is the address; the sign is only the street.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: For the fast movers, Mercury was at 3.2° Libra, Venus was at 24.3° Cancer, Mars was at 24.9° Cancer. Read together: thought that travels by comparison; attraction that works by atmosphere; effort that surges when it matters.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Closest first: Mars to Neptune, an opposition with 0.4° of slack. Oppositions are read as full-moon geometry — maximum visibility between two needs that share one spine. Behind it, Venus conjunction Mars at 0.6°, and Uranus sextile Pluto at 0.7° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. All of it stands whatever the hour was: each angle was tested from midnight to midnight before it was written down.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: Mercury opposes Saturn while both square Jupiter. A t-square aims the whole axis at its apex planet; the tradition reads it as the chart’s standing assignment. The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Read against the old dignities, three placements stand out. Mars in Cancer at 24.9° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Jupiter in Capricorn at 7.8° is in fall; Saturn in Aries at 5.8° is in fall. Dignity is a statement about conditions, not about worth.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Of the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: 3 in earth, 2 in air, 2 in water, 2 in fire by element, 6 cardinal, 2 mutable, 1 fixed by modality. Earth counts what remains: the built, the kept, the finished. Promise weighs less than delivery. Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune were retrograde — the backward drift a body appears to make as the Earth overtakes it, read in the scheme as a function that reviews before it releases.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Aries into Taurus during that day at the birthplace, travelling 13.5° between one midnight and the next. A birth time would settle it in a second; there isn’t one. So the Moon stays unnamed here — the alternative is a guess wearing the clothes of a fact.
